problem: Recovery candidates are append-only and preflight overlap checks are raceable, so concurrent workers can create multiple recovery claims for one stale opportunity before observing each other; the broad-wave stress verifier measured four overlapping recovery claims on one incident, and this worker observed two fresh recovery runs for O-SURFACE-FACULTAD_DIGITAL-DISCOVER-V1 at 09:59/10:00.
acceptance: Two or more concurrent repository recovery attempts for one stale opportunity yield exactly one active durable recovery ownership fence.
Losers receive durable collision evidence and do not create overlapping recovery runs or write candidates.
Late original returns and previous recovery attempts remain preserved and reconciliable.
Fence creation cannot mutate the original claim or confer Current, Human Accepted, Served or promotion authority.
title: Add atomic recovery ownership fence
mission: Implement and canary a repository-host create-if-absent recovery ownership fence, keyed to the stale opportunity/recovery epoch before a worker persists recovery claim/run artifacts, so concurrent recoverers cannot both become active writers. Integrate the fence with the existing lease/retry primitives while preserving append-only original and late-return evidence.

goal_relevance.reason: Production /w readiness is explicitly blocked by the stress verifier while recovery exclusive ownership fails under broad /wc concurrency.

incident_repair.reason: The verifier measured four overlapping recovery claims and this worker independently observed another same-opportunity pair of recovery runs, showing preflight overlap checks do not form a host-level exclusive fence.

unblock_value.reason: A passing atomic recovery-ownership canary directly addresses the verifier's blocking FAIL mechanism instead of adding more recovery prose or another scanner.

regression_prevention.reason: A concurrent host-level canary can permanently distinguish safe one-winner recovery from raceable refetch/overlap logic.

falsification: Two concurrent recovery executors can both obtain active ownership for the same stale opportunity/recovery epoch.
A losing fence attempt can still create an overlapping recovery run or material candidate write.
The fence mutates or deletes the original claim/recovery evidence instead of preserving lineage.
Late original RETURN cannot be reconciled after a recovery fence has been acquired.
Fence acquisition grants or implies Current, Human Accepted, Served or promotion authority.
dedup_note: The existing lease/retry build owns stale/recovery decision primitives but explicitly leaves host persistence to a separately authorized executor. The stress verifier later proved recovery exclusive ownership FAIL and routed the fix back to that owner. No inspected proposal pin matched this narrower host-level atomic recovery-fence identity; this proposal does not duplicate the separate live CLAIM_ATTEMPT receipt proposal P-04df793d0713-e1aaac9c.
